name: 2022-2c-parcial1
title: Ahoy! Pirate Crew
description: A crew of three kinds of pirates (corsair, filibuster, buccaneer) moves across an island grid with tree, dig and free cells to bury a treasure while drawing a map that only a Captain can read. The student must refactor the given, working, badly designed model and its tests: remove duplication, replace isKindOf:/symbol ifs with polymorphism, use collection protocol, and improve names, categories and encapsulation without breaking the tests.

design.notes: Crew>>moveTo: and buryTreasureAt: are nested isKindOf: x terrain-symbol ifs over a heterogeneous pirates collection, ranks are symbols duplicated in three pirate classes, and Island/Map use index whileTrue: loops that should become includes:/detect:/inject:; the tests repeat the same fixture eight times.
